handoff.contract_boundary: Checked semantics are for running states, not only final mathematical sums. Errors can depend on order, partitioning, DISTINCT hash-set iteration and window transition order. Engine adds entering rows before retracting old rows, so successive single-row i64MAX frames now explicitly error on their transient union even though each final frame fits. This deliberate conservative behavior change was approved by parent and has exact before-success and after-error evidence. No widening/deferred general numeric state.
handoff.preserved: Float64 original summation/grouped paths and rounding retained. Common DISTINCT checked constructor is opt-in only for SUM; existing AVG consumers untouched. Native arbitrary-precision data SUM and established result representations pass prior contracts.
handoff.failure_handling: Scalar/sliding batches stage sums and counts, leaving state unchanged on error. Grouped/map accumulators poison partially modified state and reject emission/reuse. Counter merges/retractions checked. NULL/FILTER masks retained, converted group states share primitive buffers.
handoff.memory: Sliding DISTINCT size estimates retained allocation from peak usable HashMap capacity using existing bucket estimator with saturating fallback. It is not exact heap accounting or global admission guarantee. State serialization can expand from distinct cardinality to valid frame row count; current public window execution never serializes this state.
